universal-healthcare: The government should provide universal healthcare.
raise-minimum-wage: The minimum wage should be raised substantially.
markets-allocate-better: Free markets allocate resources better than governments do.
public-ownership: Major industries like energy, rail and utilities should be publicly owned.
tax-the-wealthy: Taxes on the wealthy should be significantly higher.
unions-good: Labor unions are good for workers and for society.
property-fundamental: Private property is a fundamental right that should be very hard to override.
regulate-corporations: Corporations should be more tightly regulated.
cut-welfare: Welfare programs create dependency and should be cut.
worker-ownership: Workers should collectively own the businesses they work in.
surveillance-ok: Government surveillance is acceptable if it prevents terrorism.
legalize-drugs: Recreational drugs should be legal for adults.
restrict-hate-speech: Hate speech should be legally restricted.
strong-leader: A strong leader who can bypass political gridlock would benefit the country.
state-harmful: The state itself is unnecessary and harmful.
limit-guns: Gun ownership should be strictly limited.
empower-police-military: The police and military need more funding and authority.
legalize-sex-work: Sex work between consenting adults should be legal.
decide-locally: Decisions should be made as locally as possible rather than by national government.
rehabilitation: Prisons should focus on rehabilitation rather than punishment.
traditional-family: Traditional family structures are the foundation of a healthy society.
abortion-legal: Abortion should be legal in most cases.
more-religion-public: Religion should play a larger role in public life.
correct-racial-injustice: Society should actively work to correct historical racial injustices.
gender-social-construct: Gender is primarily a social construct.
preserve-national-culture: Preserving national culture and traditions is important.
gradual-change: Social change should be gradual and respect established institutions.
empower-international-orgs: International organizations like the UN should have more power.
free-trade: Free trade benefits everyone in the long run.
nation-first: My country should put its own interests ahead of global cooperation.
humanitarian-intervention: Military intervention abroad is sometimes necessary to protect human rights.
open-borders: National borders should eventually be open.
limit-growth: Economic growth should be limited to protect the environment.
drastic-climate-action: Climate change requires drastic government action.
tech-solves-problems: Technological progress will solve most of humanity's problems.
revolution-justified: Revolution is sometimes justified to achieve political change.
experts-over-public: Experts should have more say in policy than the general public.
central-planning: A centrally planned economy can work better than a market economy.
socialized-markets: Markets are acceptable as long as businesses are owned by their workers or the public.
land-value-tax: A tax on the value of land should replace most other taxes.
tax-inheritance: Large inheritances should be heavily taxed.
basic-income: Every adult should receive an unconditional basic income from the state.
tariffs-protect-industry: Tariffs should protect domestic industry from foreign competition.
state-directs-investment: The state should direct investment toward strategic industries.
widespread-small-property: Property should be spread widely among small owners rather than concentrated in corporations or the state.
abolish-money-wages: Money and wage labor should eventually be abolished.
abolish-central-banks: Central banks should be abolished and money left to the market.
corporatist-bargaining: Employers and workers should be organized into state-recognized bodies that set wages and prices together.
one-party-rule: A single party guided by the correct ideology should lead the state.
monarchy-legitimate: A hereditary monarch can be a legitimate and good head of state.
democracy-best: Democracy is the best form of government, even when voters choose badly.
direct-votes: Citizens should vote directly on major laws rather than leaving them to representatives.
workers-councils: Workers' councils, not parliaments, should be the basis of political power.
right-to-secede: Regions should have the right to secede from the country.
natural-rulers: Some people are naturally better suited to rule than others.
war-builds-character: War can strengthen a nation's character.
separate-church-state: Religion and the state should be strictly separated.
laws-from-scripture: Laws should be based on religious scripture.
private-courts-defense: Courts, policing and defense could be provided by private companies.
military-superiority: My country should maintain military superiority over its rivals.
ethnic-nation: A nation should be made up mainly of one ethnic group.
class-struggle-history: Class conflict is the main driving force of history.
equal-outcomes: Society should aim for equality of outcomes, not only of opportunity.
indigenous-land-authority: Indigenous peoples should have authority over their traditional lands.
colonial-reparations: Former colonial powers owe reparations to the nations they colonized.
civilizational-union: Nations that share a religion or civilization should unite politically.
self-interest-moral: Pursuing your own self-interest is morally good.
duties-before-rights: Citizens' duties to their community come before their individual rights.
nature-intrinsic-value: Nature has value in itself, apart from its usefulness to humans.
limit-population: Population growth should be actively limited.
industrial-civilization-disaster: Industrial civilization has been a disaster for humanity.
accelerate-technology: Society should speed up technological change even if it disrupts existing institutions.
human-enhancement: People should be free to enhance their bodies and minds with technology.
algorithmic-government: AI and algorithms should take over more government decision-making.
unbreakable-encryption: People should be able to use encryption the government cannot break.
restore-past-order: Restoring a lost social order matters more than pursuing progress.
results-over-ideology: Policies should be judged by their results, not by whether they fit an ideology.
direct-action: Political change should come through direct action rather than through elections and parliaments.
means-match-ends: The methods used to change society should reflect the society one wants to create.
return-to-foraging: Humanity would be better off returning to a hunter-gatherer way of life.
abolish-division-of-labor: The division of labor should be abolished.
distribute-by-need: Goods should ultimately be distributed according to each person's needs rather than their work or wealth.
production-for-use: Goods and services should be produced to meet people's needs rather than to make a profit.
profit-exploitation: Profit made from owning businesses comes from exploiting the workers who produce it.
dictatorship-of-proletariat: After a revolution, the working class should hold dictatorial power over the former ruling classes until classes disappear.
collective-farming: Agricultural land should be farmed collectively rather than by individual farmers.
capitalism-causes-war: Capitalism inevitably leads to imperialism and wars between the great powers.
taxation-theft: Taxation is a form of theft or forced labor.
harm-principle: The state may restrict what adults do only to prevent harm to others.
individual-rights-only: Rights belong to individuals, not to groups.
conscription: The government should be able to conscript citizens into military service.
exit-over-voice: The freedom to leave a country is a more important check on government than the right to vote.
state-as-business: Governments should be run like businesses, with citizens treated as customers who can leave.
media-academia-power: Universities and the news media together hold more real political power than elected officials.
hereditarian-race: Average differences in ability between racial groups are largely genetic.
organic-representation: Citizens should be represented through families, local communities and trade bodies rather than through political parties.
total-state: The state should direct every area of life, including culture, education and the economy.
national-rebirth: The nation needs a radical rebirth to overcome a period of decadence.
territorial-expansion: A strong nation should expand its territory and influence abroad.
personal-loyalty-rule: Political authority should rest on personal oaths of loyalty between lords and their followers.
bound-labor: Those who farm the land should be legally bound to it and owe labor to its lord.
knowledge-power: Claims to objective knowledge are shaped by the interests of those in power.
universal-morality: There are universal moral truths, knowable by reason, that hold across all cultures.
single-common-good: Politics should aim at one common good worked out by reason, rather than balancing the competing interests of different groups.
jewish-state-israel: The Jewish people have a right to a state of their own in the Land of Israel.
diaspora-return-right: Members of a nation's diaspora should have the right to return to its homeland and become citizens.
revive-national-language: A national language that has fallen out of everyday use should be revived as the language of the state.
workplace-democracy: Workers and the public should have a democratic vote in how large companies are run.
school-vouchers: Parents should receive public vouchers to spend on any school they choose.
avoid-deficit-stimulus: Governments should avoid running large budget deficits to stimulate the economy.
economic-freedom: Political freedom cannot last without economic freedom.
rule-by-example: Government should rely on the moral example of its rulers more than on laws and punishments.
national-self-determination: Every nation has the right to govern itself in its own state.
force-without-un: My country should be willing to use force abroad without approval from the UN Security Council.
reason-over-faith: Reason, not faith or emotion, should be the only guide to knowledge and action.
welfare-for-citizens: Welfare benefits should be reserved for citizens rather than extended to immigrants.
work-for-welfare: People who are able to work should be required to do so in order to receive welfare benefits.
class-collaboration: Employers and workers should cooperate as partners rather than struggle as opposed classes.
sacrifice-heritage: Museums, libraries and other inherited cultural institutions should be sacrificed if they hold back new creation.
dominated-front: Countries that see themselves as dominated by the leading Western powers should form a common front against them.
workers-nation: The working class should organize along national lines rather than as an international class.
positive-liberty: Freedom requires that people have the material means to act on it, not only the absence of interference.
distinct-gender-roles: Law should reflect distinct roles for men and women in public life.
ban-interest: Lending money at interest should be prohibited by law.
racial-segregation-law: The law should classify people by race and keep the races separate in where they live, study and use public facilities.
